title: The Anime Book Club Podcast
author: The Anime Book Club Podcast
description: Tired of the same old top trending anime recommendation lists that all look the same? Want something more than a list? Like somewhere you can go for in-depth reviews and real talk about anime with people looking for the same? Then join your hosts, Greg and JC, as they serve up fresh takes on anime with reviews that cover everything from cult classics to hidden gems to controversial favorites. Plus get their unfiltered hot-takes, ridiculous rants and astute observations on all things anime. Join the conversation every Tuesday and follow us on IG for news, updates and exclusive content!
